in_marathi.name: Gandharv
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Heavenly musician, Celestial being
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gandharv हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Gandharvs are divine musicians who live in the heavens and are the charioteers of the gods. They are considered to be the embodiment of music and artistic creativity. Gandharvs are often depicted as beautiful, graceful beings with the power to charm with their music and enchanting voices.
